text:
riley: Hey finance 1 — got a $30 'Lounge Guest' fee on the Redwood corpcard at LAX last night. I was traveling with my spouse who helped run notes for a client setup. Is the guest fee reimbursable? cc @megan
megan: Policy usually doesn't cover personal guest charges on corpcard. Did your spouse actively support the client meeting (e.g., note-taking, setup)? If so we can consider a manager exception but need a short justification.
riley: They helped set up slides, stayed in the room during prep, and are on the meeting invite. I can upload the invite + a screenshot of the digital lounge confirmation. No printed itemized receipt from the lounge. Card last4: XXXX-2468.
sam: Finance here 1 — corpcard charges require an itemized receipt or manager approval for exceptions. Guest fees are capped at $25 by default unless pre-approved. Please confirm amount and attach docs in Expensify.
riley: Charge is $30. Uploaded to Expensify: https://expensify.com/report/lounge-guest-207 (meeting invite, lounge digital confirmation, boarding pass). Category set to 'Travel - Lounges'.
hana: Noted. Since this exceeds the $25 guest cap, we need explicit manager approval for the $5 overage. @megan can you confirm?
megan: I approve the full $30 as a one-time exception. Reason: spouse provided documented onsite support for client setup. Recording approval: "manager exception approved for documented meeting support."
expensify-bot: Expense received: Report lounge-guest-207, total $30.00, status 'Submitted' 1 awaiting finance review.
sam: Finance approves with manager exception recorded. Reimbursement for $30 will go through, but please ensure the expense notes include guest name + meeting time for audit. We'll process on the next payroll run (ETA ~10 business days). Tagging payments ops for reconciliation.
riley: Added guest name (Alex Riley) and meeting time to notes. Thanks!
payments-bot: Reconciliation note created: will match corpcard descriptor 'LAX LOUNGE GST' to Expensify report lounge-guest-207. Case PR-4501 opened for audit trail.
